story.fullStory:
Fifth Harmony's "Worth It" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Worth It" is a song by American girl group Fifth Harmony, featuring American rapper Kid Ink.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 36 weeks on the chart.

Worth It was released in 2015.

Artist: Fifth Harmony · Title: Worth It · Album: Fifth Harmony Featuring Kid Ink - Worth It · Year: 2015 · Genre: Pop · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2010's/Fifth Harmony - Worth It.mp4
"Worth It" is a song by American girl group Fifth Harmony, featuring American rapper Kid Ink.
It impacted American rhythmic crossover radio on March 2, 2015, as the third and final single from the group's debut studio album, Reflection (2015).
Written by Priscilla Renea and its producers Stargate, "Worth It" is a dance-pop and R&B song that incorporates a strong use of Balkan music and Middle Eastern music in its production.
Reflection is the debut studio album by American girl group Fifth Harmony.
It was released on January 30, 2015, by Syco Music and Epic Records.
Lyrically, the album discusses themes of female-empowerment, romance, heartbreak and confidence.
